items.title: How Many Shares of Bristol Myers Squibb, Merck or Gilead Sciences Pay $1,000 a Month in Dividends?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, $1,000 a month in dividends takes about 4,762 shares of Bristol Myers Squibb, about 3,530 shares of Merck or about 3,659 shares of Gilead Sciences. Bristol Myers Squibb’s check is the cheapest at about $292,100, while Gilead’s costs about $623,000.
